segments.oily: Several reviewers describing oily or acne-prone skin report the cream absorbs without a greasy cast and does not add oiliness, though one with combo/oily skin developed cystic acne and clogged pores after weeks of use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, very dry, or flaky skin most consistently report significant overnight hydration, softness and relief from tightness or flaking, especially in winter.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe it as usable for light slugging without heaviness, though one notes it should be used only 1-2 times a week rather than nightly.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive, reactive, eczema-prone or Rosacea-affected reviewers report calming, soothing effects with no irritation, including cases where Cerave or Cetaphil had previously caused reactions.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 60s-70s report visibly softer, moister, more luminous skin with continued nightly use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it alongside retinol or tretinoin report plumper, glowing skin and reduced dryness/peeling from those treatments; mature-skin reviewers also report softer, more luminous skin over months of use.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority report strong overnight hydration and softness, particularly for dry or dehydrated winter skin; a minority say it sat on top of skin and did not moisturize or absorb at all.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with red, irritated or rosacea-prone skin report calming and soothing effects and reduced redness.
concerns.barrier: Some reviewers credit it with protecting or restoring the skin barrier, including one recovering from a reaction to another product and one on Accutane with barrier damage; no barrier-related complaints were reported.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and some describe it as gentle enough for active acne treatment routines; however multiple reviewers report clogged pores or cystic breakouts after two to three weeks of use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-leaning reviewers mostly report no added oiliness or greasy feel, describing it as surprisingly light despite the thick texture.

extraits.titre: Not for oily dry combo skin
extraits.texte: Tried to love this product for the past 3 months but every time I use it I break out in horrible cystic acne that clears up a week after I stop using this cream. It also feels heavy and clogging not like other over night masks, it activly feels like my skin is suffocating while using this. Overall do not recommend considering the price and the simple fact that it does not hydrate my skin at all. Will be theowing out.

I've been in search of a night cream that's acne friendly so I gave this cream a shot. This cream has a chunky texture which I thought was weird at first, but I rubbed it in between my hands which smoothed it out then applied it to my face. The cream definitely left my skin super soft and hydrated when I woke up in the morning, but after 2 weeks of using it, I noticed a bunch of clogged pores all over my chin :( I have acne prone skin so I wouldn't say this cream is acne friendly.

extraits.titre: Good daily moisturizer for DRY skin
extraits.texte: I have DRY sensitive, red, itchy eczema skin. This is the first thing I've found so far that soothes, moisturizes and keeps my skin moisturzed all day. Great stuff!

I have been on accutane for the last 4 months now and after month 3 I started getting extremely dry and red, irritated skin. This was all new for me since I'm typically crazy oily (but that's just the meds doing its job!). I had been searching far and wide for a night time occlusive that is also very calming, but friendly for very sensitive/reactive skin. This cream is PERFECT. I would describe it as a balm/cream hybrid. It has no fragrance, no essential oils, is very silky, and I wake up with beautiful hydrated and calmed skin. I think any of the bad reviews are focused on the texture and maybe need to apply it differently. Start with your normal skincare routine and use a regular moisturizer (I use Cerave lotion). Then as your last step apply this product to seal everything in. Take out a small dollop and warm the product up between your fingers until it starts to smooth. Dab little dots all over your face and lightly rub in. I use this every night now as my skin is very dry, but I can imagine this cream would be helpful to people even with combo/oily skin as its not super greasy. Maybe just once or twice a week as a nice hydrating mask. I cant wait to try other products once I'm finished with my treatment!!

I'm really impressed with this cream. I have combination and sensitive skin that gets dehydrated in the winter. It's not easy to find creams that hit the right balance of moisture/occlusivity, that don't clog pores and are fragrance free. But so far this has hit the mark, and without shea butter (which is usually way too much for my skin type). My skin is baby soft and I've been using it day and night. I also appreciate that it contains some gentle vit c to help subtly brighten my skin. Thank you so much Susan!

I've been battling dry skin with my pregnancy and this leaves my screen hydrated and baby smooth. I have oily/acne prone skin and this doesn't cause more breakouts or leave it feeling greasy. The consistency is thicker so would recommend only using 1-2x a week depending on your needs
I have used this for 6 months straight and my mature skin is soft, moist, and luminous in the morning when I wake up. Great product!
